verdict.rationale: The docs name /llms.txt as the file to point a coding agent at, saying it teaches the whole protocol in one fetch, and the homepage tells users to give the agent `set up treg - https://treg.to/llms.txt`. A probe confirms llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with substantive protocol content, and markdown docs (tutorial.md, feedback.md) plus openapi.json are also served for agents. missing for 10: independent/community reports of agents successfully onboarding via llms.txt, and a markdown version of the main docs page (docs.md returns 404).
